title: ResourcesManifest
description: alias -> descriptor, derived from the original RSX object in app/data/resources.js. The 'plist' field of the original descriptors is intentionally dropped; frame data lives in atlases.json.

additionalProperties.description: One resource descriptor, keyed by its alias (e.g. f1GeneralIdle).

img.description: Atlas/texture PNG path (relative to assets/). Required for texture/sprite/animation.

frame.description: sprite only: frame name within the atlas.

audio.description: audio only: sound file path (relative to assets/).
